Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: InfoHighway is a fully operational national data exchange platform. As of 2025, it has 33 government publisher organizations, 192 system connections, and over 600 e-services relying on it. It operates 24/7 with constant monitoring (929+ days of smooth running documented). Hosted at Government Online Centre (GOC) on government intranet. Uses publisher-subscriber model with no data storage (live data fetched from source databases). Governed by High-Level Management Team chaired by MITCI. Launched operationally from January 2017. Users include MRA, Civil Status Division, CBRD, EDB, Bank of Mauritius, Police, and others. Score 5: fully operational.
